description: This file defines the interface 'TableMappingInterface' for mapping entity fields to SQL tables in Drupal, including methods for retrieving table names, columns, and generating column names.

classes.name: TableMappingInterface
classes.description: Defines methods for mapping entity fields to SQL tables and columns in Drupal.

methods.name: getTableNames
methods.description: Returns a list of table names for the mapping.

methods.name: getAllColumns
methods.description: Returns all database columns for a specified table.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns entity field names stored in a specified table.

methods.name: getColumnNames
methods.description: Returns database columns for a specific entity field.

methods.name: getExtraColumns
methods.description: Returns extra denormalized database columns for a table.

methods.name: getReservedColumns
methods.description: Returns columns that cannot be used as field type columns.

methods.name: getFieldColumnName
methods.description: Generates a unique column name for a field property.

methods.name: getFieldTableName
methods.description: Returns the table name for a given entity field.

methods.name: getAllFieldTableNames
methods.description: Returns all tables storing a specific entity field.

search-terms: entity field to SQL table mapping
